notes.title: Patch 27 December 2023
notes.notes:
[ GAMEPLAY ]

 Fixed bomb sound: Adjusted the bomb explosion audio for better quality and impact.
 Fixed aspect ratio glitches: Now compatible with most common screen sizes for a seamless visual experience.
 Removed the buggy ship in level 5: Enhanced gameplay flow and reduced frustration by addressing the glitch.


[ VISUAL ENHANCEMENTS ]

 Added a particle effect in the Space DLC exit: Stars now form a Milky Way-like visual, making the exit more majestic and thematic.
 Changed the size and color of the Continue button: Improved visibility and aesthetics, offering a more intuitive navigation experience.

notes.title: Pirate Jam Update & Space DLC Launch: A Galactic Adventure Awaits!
notes.notes:
🌟 Ahoy, Pirate Jammers! 🚀

Exciting tides bring us the latest update for Pirate Jam and the launch of the Space DLC, opening a gateway to the stars! Here’s what’s new:

🎲 Pirate Jam Base Game Update:

Space DLC Integration: Journey into new dimensions of puzzles.
Space Level Editor: Design your own galactic challenges.
New Music Tracks: Tune into the cosmic vibes.
Updated Screenshot Size for Level Upload: Capture your creativity.
All Missing Translations Added: Pirate Jam in your language.
New Achievement - Mine Sweeper: Skill-testing, reward-earning.
Reworked Levels 4-20: Enhanced complexity for better challenge.
Translated Endscreen & Edited Text: Improved endgame clarity.
New Achievements for Space DLC: Unlock more as you explore the cosmos.


🌌 Space DLC Features:

New Levels: Conquer unique space-themed puzzles.
Space-Themed Challenges: Black holes, laser dodges, cosmic feats.
Astronomical Aesthetics: Breathtaking space visuals.
Unique Sound Effects: Immerse in the sounds of space.
Special Easter Eggs: Hidden secrets await.
Engaging Storyline: A new chapter in your Pirate Jam adventure.
Space Level Editor: Craft your own interstellar puzzles.


🚀 Special Launch Offer!
The Space DLC is available at a special price of [color=red]$0.64[/color]! This offer sails away after [color=cyan]December 27th[/color], so catch it while it orbits!

🛸 About the Space DLC:
Embark on an interstellar voyage with Pirate Jam's Space DLC. Not just an expansion, but a whole new realm to explore, filled with puzzles and mysteries that echo the wonders of the universe. Perfect for space enthusiasts and puzzle solvers alike, it's your chance to navigate the uncharted territories of the cosmos, all for the price of a starry coffee!

Set your compass for the stars and let the cosmic adventure begin! Happy space sailing! 🌠🏴‍☠️🎮

notes.title: Set Sail with Pirate Jam's New Update - Now Live!
notes.notes:
Ahoy there, mates! We're thrilled to announce that the much-anticipated update for Pirate Jam is now LIVE! We can't wait for you to dive in and explore all the new features that we've crafted just for you.

Ever dreamt of designing your own harbor or creating your own levels? The brand new Level Editor is here to fulfill your dreams. It's your chance to put your creativity to the test and design your own custom levels that will challenge even the most seasoned sailors!

But why keep all the fun to yourself? With our Steam Workshop integration, you can share your cunningly crafted levels with the world. Show off your level designing skills, challenge friends and other players, and try your hand at navigating through their creations.

Last, but not least, we've heard your feedback and we're happy to announce that your volume settings will now be saved. No more adjustments each time you restart the game. Your pirate music will play just as you like it every time.

As with any voyage into new waters, there might be a few unexpected waves along the way. If you encounter any bugs or issues, please bear with us. We're committed to making your Pirate Jam experience as smooth as possible, and we'll be working diligently to fix any issues that arise over time.

We're excited to see what you all will create, and we're looking forward to sailing through the creative harbors you design. Get ready to embark on a new adventure with this exciting update. Happy sailing, and may the wind be ever in your sails!

The Pirate Jam Dev Team
